root_cause: (1) pollCast derived the next own seq only from stored/queued own votes, so a vote that went out but was not stored locally (save failure or indeterminate send) left no trace and the next cast reused its seq. (2) settleHeldCloses tallied every stored vote, including early votes that this member received AFTER the held close (the open-time replay stores them first), while the open-first path drops a vote arriving after the close — the closed tally depended on where the open landed. (3) The dispatcher acks a live rumor in finally whatever its handlers do, so a poll_close announcement (and, same class, a kind-12 close) whose storage read failed was lost; the unknown-poll branch swallowed a failed hold, which the held-announcement replay then treated as completed. Replay clean-up (removePendingVotes) failures also failed the whole open/close/gate.
fix: pollPersistence: per-poll own seq reservation (few:poll-vote-seq:{groupId}, lower-cased voter, never lowered; loadVoteSeqReservation/reserveVoteSeq; cleared by clearPollData/clearAllPollData); PollVote.receivedAt stamped by saveVoteIfNewer when absent from receiptNow() (strictly increasing per page; queue defaults use it too). pollCast: seq = max(stored, queued, reservation)+1, reservation awaited BEFORE send (read or write failure -> no send). pollReplay: replayed votes keep their queue receivedAt; removePendingVotes best-effort (logged). pollHandler: settleHeldCloses tallies only votes with receivedAt <= earliest creator held close receivedAt (rows without receivedAt count); handleClose holds the close (pending-close queue, authenticated sender) when getPoll / replay / tally read / closed save fails, then rethrows. chatHandler gate: getPoll or loadVotesWithPending failure holds the announcement in the existing queue then rethrows; unknown-poll hold failure now throws; a closed poll announces its stored results (no vote read). Ordering key decision (local receipt order, not sender created_at) recorded in the report.
deviations_from_design: Finding 1b approach 'votedAt <= closedAt' replaced by local receipt order: sender-clock comparison only converges if closed tallies are amended by late votes (breaks 'closing is final', frozen chat summary) and lets a member back-date a vote into a closed tally. Receipt order is the key the live close already uses.

Finding 2 'rethrow so the journal does not ack' is not available: applicationRumorDispatcher acks in finally regardless of handler outcome. The held close / held announcement queues (retried by settleHeldCloses at the next poll message) are the retry mechanism; throws are kept so the replayer keeps entries and the dispatcher logs.

Scope extended (same lost-on-failure class): live kind-12 close held on failure; removePendingVotes made best-effort; gate uses stored results for closed polls (needed so the summary matches the cut-off tally).

verification_answers.VQ-1: Yes. 'send succeeds but the local save fails -> the next cast uses seq + 1' (sends [1, 2]); reservation read before send = 1; reservation write/read failure -> send not called; lands-then-rejects -> next cast seq 2.
verification_answers.VQ-2: Yes, with local receipt order as the key (decision in report). All 4 open positions give {A:1,B:0}; close->vote->open equals open->close->vote.
verification_answers.VQ-3: Yes. Success-signal test: failing first getPoll -> no row; next poll message appends it once with the stored tally; second message appends nothing. Failed hold throws (chatHandler tests) — no silent completion.
verification_answers.VQ-4: Yes. saveVoteIfNewer / removePendingVotes injected at the open, the live close (and its fault matrix), and the chat gate replay; stored state checked; convergence on the next message.
verification_answers.VQ-5: Yes. polls.md (§ordering, §3, §5, §7, §8, Sources) and AC-9 amended; unit 5487 passed / 1 skipped, tsc clean; Stryker survivors justified.

open_questions: Product (follow-up the lead is filing): a held close/summary is retried only by a later message of the same poll (now including its results summary). With none, it stays held until the 7-day expiry; no startup sweep was added.

Product: votes in flight at the close still count on some members and not others (receipt order). Converging across members needs send-time comparison plus amending closed tallies (trades finality and back-dating resistance); recorded in polls.md section 5.

Bounds: at most 20 votes per voter and poll are kept for as-of tallies; beyond that a held close received before all kept votes does not count that voter (tested; held-close-aware pruning is a follow-up). Browsers without Web Locks serialise seq allocation within a tab only (multi-tab epic).

retrospective.harder_than_needed: Both findings prescribed a mechanism that does not hold against the current code: 'votedAt <= closedAt' cannot make the two orders agree without amending closed tallies, and 'rethrow so the journal does not ack' is impossible because the dispatcher acks in finally. Each needed a fresh ordering/retry decision; a Fable design consult up front (as the prior run had) would have settled them before implementation.
retrospective.surprised_by: Date.now()-granularity ties made the receipt cut-off flaky in tests (same-millisecond close and vote); a strictly increasing per-page receipt clock was needed.

remediation_round_1.trigger: Reviewer ACCEPTED; Codex 2 high (vote change across a held close counted with neither vote; seq reuse across tabs) + mediums (unknown-state live close dropped; receipt clock not persistent) + reviewer F2/F4. Decider: lead, RETRY with 5 items.
fix: F1: handleClose holds the close (holdAfterFailure, throws) when recoverHeldCloses returns unknown.

Item 2 (F5/F4): keptVotes (drop a vote only if another is at least as new by the order AND arrived no later; identical votes collapse; cap MAX_VOTES_KEPT_PER_VOTER=5, earliest-received dropped) for the early-vote queue (several entries per voter+poll; per-voter bound counts distinct polls) and the stored row (PollVote.superseded; the row stays the newest vote). Held-close tally = voteAsOf(row, closeReceipt). F4 handled by the same merge rather than skipping the save: skipping needs a held-close read on every live vote and loses the vote if that held close is a non-creator one.

Item 3 (F3): allocateVoteSeq(group, poll, voter, floor): atomic read-max-increment-write returning max(last+1, floor), inside the per-key queue and under navigator.locks.request('few:poll-vote-seq:'+groupId) when available; replaces reserveVoteSeq; pollCast allocates before sending.
Item 4 (F6): receiptNow is async, seeded from the persisted few:poll-receipt-clock mark leased 60 s ahead (max-preserving write, non-finite marks ignored, failures logged and retried).
Item 5 (F2 partial): the chat gate poll_close branch calls settleHeldCloses (createHeldCloseSettler, late-bound in registerHandlers) without replaying held summaries; unknown holds the summary.
